resources.string: Terminals use a directory independent of conversations by default. A directory selected in Files applies only to a new terminal. Shares the app UID. The default lease is two hours; detached terminals are reclaimed after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Terminal could not open. Try Repair and open.
Disconnected. Leaving the page or switching conversations does not stop commands. Reconnect to view retained output.
Old terminal ended · Command outcome unknown
The old terminal status is unknown. You can open an independent terminal.
The terminal is still stopping. Try closing it again shortly.
Some input was rejected or its outcome is unknown. It was not resent. Check the terminal before entering more.
Output connection failed. Leave the page and reconnect to the original terminal.
Older output was discarded. The display restarted from retained content.
Current connection is in read-only observer mode
Open a terminal to use the bundled Linux environment.

Terminals and Agent tasks can run together. An open terminal or uncollected result does not block other tasks. Shared files can change concurrently; verify the final result. Only environment maintenance, engine capacity and input to the same terminal require coordination. Leaving detaches without stopping commands.
The terminal requires Advanced mode. Standard mode cannot start a terminal.
Switch to Advanced and start terminal
The shell could not start. Open Execution environments to repair it.
The shell did not become ready. Try opening a new terminal.
The old connection did not confirm detachment. The new terminal is open.
